metadata.title: Minimal central slices of the regular simplex
metadata.abstract: We prove that minimal-volume hyperplane sections of the regular simplex through its centroid are parallel to a facet. The proof combines variational methods with Fourier-analytic techniques and zero-diminishing arguments to show that every critical normal vector with no zero coordinates has at most three distinct values. Analysis of the two- and three-value cases then yields the sharp lower bound.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明过正单纯形重心的最小体积超平面截面平行于某个面，先将临界法向量约化到至多三个不同坐标值再分析极值。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出中心超平面截面的锐下界及最优几何构型。
analysis.limitations: 摘要的至多三值约化先针对无零坐标法向量；边界和退化法向量如何处理需核查。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 经典凸几何极值结构相关，变分与 Fourier 组合方法值得阅读。
